degree_rationale: How the elements gather inward into the cosmic body — light to fire, fire to water, water to wind, wind to Tamr, to Answer, to Call, to Mind, to Pillar, to First Man, to Ambassador, to Aeons. Natural ascent of substance into its source.
direction_rationale: Generative ordering of how the natural ascends — the recapitulation-by-stages of cosmic substance returning to source.
grand_man_function: Natural recursion — how all substance gathers homeward.
title: How the elements gather inward into the cosmic body
